dct_description_sm: A spreadsheet guide to the main categories/subjects covered in Cycles 1-26 of the General Social Survey. The categories included are defined as: Demographic Variables and Household Composition; Education; Geographic Identifiers; Income/Household Income; Immigration, language, ethnicity, religion. Specific categories related to the themes of each cycle are still to be completed.
